observations.title: Breacher timing and cover
observations.player_action: Avoid fighting beside weak cover; bait its heavy attack, then punish its stated three-second attack interval.
observations.outcome: Breacher may destroy weak blocks and disable a blocking shield for four seconds.

quest_seed.goal_ru: Переживи удар Breacher и победи его.

observations.title: Dragger web control
observations.player_action: Avoid pillaring up without an escape path; its web snare can restrict movement and pull victims.

quest_seed.goal_ru: Одолей Dragger, не позволив поймать себя паутиной.

observations.title: Bowlder counterplay
observations.player_action: After the Wither milestone, fight a Bowlder with a pickaxe to bypass its heavy damage reduction; avoid arrows.
observations.outcome: Pickaxe bypasses the project-described reduction; Bowlder inflicts Armor Crumbling.
conditions: Wither defeat milestone (exact world-state trigger requires runtime check)
observations.review_note: Author description gives 60% reduction; JEM World Tier modifiers can change effective numbers.

observations.title: Tunnel Gore environmental weakness
observations.player_action: Find its distinctive deep tunnel, avoid over-mining, and lure charges into netherite blocks.
observations.outcome: Author describes a three-charge vulnerability that opens access to lair rewards.

quest_seed.goal_ru: Заставь Tunnel Gore трижды столкнуться с незеритом.

observations.review_note: Do not turn this into a deterministic FTB objective until a reliable event signal is found.

observations.title: Ride a temporary Quake mount
observations.player_action: Feed cactus to a Quake in desert terrain and use its temporary riding ability.
observations.outcome: Mounted Quake can produce a powerful area attack.

observations.title: Workshop coatings
observations.player_action: Use the Workshop to apply suitable coating items to compatible gear.
observations.outcome: Special coating effects on tools, armor and weapons.

quest_seed.goal_ru: Используй мастерскую, чтобы нанести первое покрытие на снаряжение.

observations.review_note: Which coating works on which item is context/tooltip dependent; no fabricated universal compatibility.

observations.title: Wretch depends on Alex's Caves
observations.player_action: Treat the Wretch content as survival-obtainable only when Alex's Caves is present.

quest_seed.goal_ru: Найди Wretch в связке Skarrier Mobs и Alex’s Caves.

observations.review_note: Verify biome/spawn criteria from installed config and code before generating a locate/kill quest.

observations.title: Endorah release addition
observations.player_action: Treat Endorah as a boss added in Skarrier Mobs 1.1.1; do not invent a summoning ritual from the release note.
observations.outcome: Adds boss encounter and related Voidrake, Frost, Freeze mobs.
observations.review_note: The installed 1.1.1 predates the hotfix; author later fixed a Frost mob crash. Do not assume the hotfix is installed.

observations.title: Skarrier illager support
observations.player_action: Focus the Sorcerer during raids before it buffs allied illagers with healing, speed or strength.
observations.outcome: More dangerous cross-mob interaction in raids.

quest_seed.goal_ru: Выведи из боя Sorcerer во время рейда.
